```{r, echo=TRUE,results='hide',fig.keep='all'}
# Clusters on S^2
set.seed(100)
n <- 210
d <- 3
k <- 100
nspheres <- 1
cluster1 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster2 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
cluster3 <- rotasym::r_vMF(n / 3, c(rotasym::r_unif_sphere(1, 3)), k)
clusters <- rbind(cluster1, cluster2, cluster3)
col1 <- rep("#009999", (n / 3))
col2 <- rep("#FF0033", (n / 3))
col3 <- rep("#66FF00", (n / 3))
col <- c(col1, col2, col3)
close3d()
plot3d(clusters[, 1:3], col = col, xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1))

dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
p_curve <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, col = col, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)
close3d()
grid_size = 20
bws=c(.0625,.125,.25,1,2,4,8,16,32,64)
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 1, sharedMouse = TRUE)
res <- inverse_mds_bw(x = clusters, result = p_curve, col = col, grid_size = grid_size, bws=bws, dims = dims, angular = FALSE, method = "NW", plot = FALSE)
plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 1:3], res[, 1:3]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(col, multiple_reps(col_grad(length(bws)-1),grid_size)), pch = 16
)

```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^2)^2
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.10)

close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)

clusters <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_3[, , i])
}
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```

```{r}
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)

grid_size = 20
bws=c(.0625,.125,.25,1,2,4,8,16,32,64)
res <- inverse_mds_bw(x = clusters, result = centroid_12, grid_size = grid_size, bws=bws, dims = dims, method = "NW", angular = FALSE, plot = FALSE)

plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 1:3], res[, 1:3]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), multiple_reps(col_grad(length(bws)-1),grid_size)), pch = 16
)
plot3d(rbind(clusters[, 4:6], res[, 4:6]),
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = c(rainbow(n), multiple_reps(col_grad(length(bws)-1),grid_size)), pch = 16
)
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^2)^2, small circles, offset by .5
set.seed(5)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, t = .5, sigma = 0.10)

clusters1 <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters1 <- cbind(clusters1, samp_3[, , i])
}
clusters <- normalize_poly(clusters1, dims)
close3d()
mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
plot3d(
  clusters[, 4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", col = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)


dims <- rep(2, nspheres)
angular <- FALSE
landmark_size <- .1
tol <- 5e-3
landmark_tol <- 5e-4

time <- Sys.time()
centroid_12 <- plot_mds(x = clusters, dims = dims, landmark_size = landmark_size, angular = angular, tol = tol, landmark_tol = landmark_tol, gradient = TRUE)
print(Sys.time() - time)
```
